reasons.finding: The read-only public shell works, but the reviewed searchable corpus is still too small for a useful public search alpha.
reasons.required_response: Build candidate intake and seed batches before staging or public launch.

reasons.finding: Weak or missing local results do not yet reliably become candidate-producing source actions and review items.
reasons.required_response: Implement query-to-source-action planning, candidate lanes, source-cache handoff, and review queue intake.

reasons.finding: Public alpha must be able to search Archive.org item metadata beyond Eureka's local reviewed index, without requiring Eureka to pre-index all Archive.org records.
reasons.required_response: Use Internet Archive metadata search APIs as a governed live metadata candidate source, with rate limits, cache policy, kill switch, redaction, and review requirements.

reasons.finding: Archive.org-wide search must not mean arbitrary crawling, file downloads, extraction, execution, or automatic truth acceptance.
reasons.required_response: Keep discovery metadata-only and candidate-only until separate review and promotion gates approve records.
